title: Disruptive Innovation - Clayton Christensen (Part 2)
summary: Clayton Christensen explains disruptive innovation using the steel industry, showing how mini-mills beat incumbents from the low end. He argues disruption is not about stupid or bad management.
why: HN recommends it as an amazing, clear explanation of why incumbents move upmarket and lose to low-end challengers.

quote.text: Here's part of a great talk from Christensen describing the same logic but in the Steel industry
